<thought>The spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope with peaks spaced by ~1 Da (141 → 142 → 143 …) and intensities decreasing roughly according to the natural ¹³C abundance. This pattern is characteristic of carbon and allows us to definitively identify carbon in the sample. No 2 Da spacing or characteristic ratios for Cl, Br, S, etc., are observed, so no other element can be definitively identified from the given data.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
